title.en: christmas in cork parade, through the city centre.
title.de: christmas in cork parade, durch die innenstadt.
title.tr: christmas in cork geçit töreni, şehir merkezinden.

line.en: the parade from north main street over patrick's bridge to maccurtain street, 18:30 to 19:30. bands, dancers, french street theatre, then santa switches on the lights.
line.de: die parade von north main street über patrick's bridge zur maccurtain street, 18:30 bis 19:30. bands, tänzer, französisches straßentheater, dann schaltet der weihnachtsmann die lichter ein.
line.tr: north main street'ten patrick's bridge üzerinden maccurtain street'e, 18:30 ile 19:30 arası geçit. bantlar, dansçılar, fransız sokak tiyatrosu, sonra noel baba ışıkları yakar.

sparks.why: Christmas in Cork Parade, Sun 15 Nov 18:30 to 19:30, route and times from the Cork City Council announcement (corkcity.ie) and the Irish Examiner.
